findings: V2 canonical Snapshot.balances wire-order fix verified: runtime.rs:631 sorts balances by (&a.asset, &a.account) where AssetId (ir.rs:104-111) orders by (network, issuer, reference, scale). Because BOND < CASH under identical network/issuer ("local", "financial-pair-reserve"), the simultaneous positional permutation [0,1,3,2,4,5,6] yielding [auditor/BOND, observer/BOND, reserve/BOND, observer/CASH, reserve/CASH, supplier/CASH, treasury/CASH] is consistently applied across reserve-approved.scenario.json, mori-tests.json expected.post.balances, and financial-and-work.json reserve.balance_columns, reserve.pre.balances, and all 15 reserve.prefixes[*].balances. Invoice balances (all CASH) remain in canonical account order [observer, payer, reserve, seller, treasury], and liabilities remain in canonical lexical name order ([invoice, warranty] and [allocation, bond, emergency]).

Complete 39-prefix and financial accounting verification: All 12 prefixes of installment-invoice first call (amount 47, atDay 30; gross debit 50, fee 3, seller net 47, treasury net 3; payer 200->153->150, seller 11->58, treasury 5->8, preserved observer 23 and reserve 19;CASH sum 258; invoice duty 127->80, preserved warranty 9; state paid 0->47, dueDay 30->60, installments 0->1, preserved marker 77), all 12 prefixes of installment-invoice final call (amount 80, atDay 60; gross debit 83, fee 3, seller net 80, treasury net 3; cumulative gross 133, fees 6, net 127; payer 150->70->67, seller 58->138, treasury 8->11; invoice 80->0 present-zero tombstone retained per runtime.rs:837-861, warranty 9 preserved; state paid 47->127, dueDay 60->90, installments 1->2, marker 77), and all 15 prefixes of conditional-reserve allocate (approved true, amount 50, bondAmount 7; fee-inclusive floor residual = (57 - 50) - 2 = 5 >= 5; allocation absent null -> accrued 50 -> discharged to present-zero 0; CASH reserve 57->7->5, supplier 5->55, treasury 1->3, observer 11, sum 74; BOND auditor 2->9, observer 7, reserve 20->13, sum 29; bond duty 10->3, emergency duty 2 preserved; state allocated 0->50, closed false->true, marker 77) match Core/1 semantics in runtime.rs.

Aggregate and per-statement logical cost verification: Under moriarty-reference-logical-cost/1 (logical_cost.rs:7-57, runtime.rs:395-431, 713), each statement charges 1 dispatch unit plus 1 unit per uncached ExprId node with a fresh cache per statement and eager boolean operand evaluation. Invoice collect statements charge [4,4,6,2,2,2,2,4,4,4,6,2] = 42 units over 12 statements per call (84 total over two calls; unrun register = 4). Reserve allocate statements charge [5,4,4,6,4,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,4,2] = 45 units over 15 statements (unrun register = 6).

Public API, successor linkage, and strict comparison verification: FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.rs imports only public mori_core items (Execution, Program, Scenario, UInt, parse, simulate, simulate_metered, validate), decodes compact prefix columns in snapshot_from_columns using only frozen expected.post identities and literal cells without arithmetic or sorting actual outputs, preserves null (absent) vs "0" (present-zero) duty distinction, verifies exact JSON equality of pre, post, effects, step count/index/statement-kind/snapshot/effects, checks aggregate CostReport {profile, cap, used} and Scenario immutability on both ordinary and metered runs, and constructs the second invoice Scenario directly from first.post.{state, balances, liabilities} with final_input.inputs before asserting exact equality with frozen invoice-final.scenario.json.
limitations: No Cargo, rustc, parser, interpreter, compiler, prover, SDK, or native execution was performed; FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.rs and all v2 oracle fixtures remain UNRUN and verified by static source and fixture inspection only.

Step.value per-kind Some/None conventions and raw Step.statement ExprId arena indices are unresolved in the oracle; the test projects Step.statement to its tag kind and does not assert Step.value or full serialized Execution byte equality. Public Step has no per-step work counter, so per-statement/cumulative work cells in financial-and-work.json are not directly observed by the test's aggregate CostReport assertion.

refusal-expectations.json is a declarative specification only (with metered cap-refusal error codes left null pending an agreed diagnostic contract) and is not executed by FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.rs or adopted as a security/hostile test here.

FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.md prose line 7 still cites the v1 FREEZE.sha256, mori-tests.json, and financial-and-work.json SHA-256 digests from before the v2 wire-order revision; the integrator should place the v2 oracle under crates/fixtures/financial-pair/ and update the companion markdown digest notes if retained.

Core/1 local simulation does not establish canonical Program/hash, compiled ZKIR/ABI/relation/statement commitments, native proofs, target/anchor/owner-intent authorization, authenticated predecessor/history/time or balance-query binding for budget 57, DUST/service/external/native costs, Core/2 durable await/continuation lowering, U2 walkthrough completion, or Cardano/Midnight ledger capture/settlement.
